infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: UpShift needs access to your photos so you can set a profile picture.

plugins.photosPermission: UpShift needs access to your photos so you can set a profile picture or analyze a meal.
plugins.cameraPermission: UpShift uses the camera so the AI coach can estimate nutrition from a photo of your meal.
UpShift uses the camera to scan the barcode on packaged food. The picture never leaves your phone; only the barcode number is looked up.

plugins.microphonePermission: UpShift uses the microphone so you can talk to your AI coach.
plugins.speechRecognitionPermission: UpShift uses speech recognition to turn your voice into text for the AI coach.
